justification: Docs-only change: adds the NDIS deep-dive Modules 6-11 final verdict (product design + red team, corpus feasibility, competition sweep, GTM + validation sprint, care-sector expansion, practitioner voice) under docs/. No code paths, no user-facing product surfaces, no database interaction, no build inputs touched. Zero .py/.ts/.tsx files in the diff vs origin/main.

break_it.scenario: Founder treats an [INFERENCE] figure (e.g. inferred July 2027 cohort size, base-case revenue projection, per-user session-time thresholds) or a search-snippet-level practitioner quote as verbatim ground truth for a build or sales decision.
break_it.what_happens: Revenue math or product-shape decisions rest on unconfirmed figures; kill criteria are triggered on the wrong evidence.
break_it.how: Every unverified claim carries an inline tag ([INFERENCE], [UNVERIFIED], [PARAPHRASE from snippet]); the Honesty Ledger enumerates every gap and how to close it; the verdict is explicitly conditional on the 5 buyer-conversation questions and carries three kill-switches with numeric triggers; owner is directed to re-run fetches from home network before locking any build.
